composers_checked.name: Boccherini, Luigi
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Wikipedia list of compositions (Gérard numbers G. 77-154, 259, 407-418) and Gérard as cited by IMSLP: added the six Piano Quintets, Op. 56, G. 407-412 (not on IMSLP; recorded complete by Ensemble Claviere and by Quartetto Elisa). Not added: G. 131-136 (spurious, attributed to Cambini), G. 137-142 (string trios without opus; not on IMSLP, no recording in MusicBrainz), G. 149-154 (piano trios "Oeuvre I/II") and G. 259 (piano quartets from the Op. 26 quartets, an arrangement): not on IMSLP and no recording in MusicBrainz. The Keyboard Trios G. 143-148 (doubtful) are on IMSLP with formation "other", so they fall to slice c28.

note: c29 Boccherini, string trios and works with piano: one composer, all 17 candidate pages covered. Kept 38 IMSLP works (32 string trios, 6 Op. 57 piano quintets) and added the six Op. 56 piano quintets (gap). Floor from Apple Music track lists (iTunes Search API, durations are means over the recordings found), MusicBrainz releases, the Brilliant Classics and French Wikipedia pages (Op. 14, Op. 34 discographies). Judgment calls: (1) Op. 1 (two violins and cello, as in the Ut Orpheus critical edition) rests on its only commercial recording (MusicWeb, 2012), by the Trio Arcophon, a violin-viola-cello trio that took violin 2 on the viola; kept, confidence medium. (2) Op. 47 No. 1, G. 107: the Wikipedia list says A-flat major, but all three recordings (Europa Galante, Ensemble Agora, La Real Cámara) say A major; titled A major. (3) Keys of G. 409 (C major) and G. 415 (E minor) follow IMSLP/Wikipedia and most recordings; single track lists give D major and E-flat major. (4) Levels are estimates: Boccherini writes the cello (his own instrument) as the leading, high-lying part in the trios, and the piano quintets' fortepiano parts are moderate; no score was graded bar by bar. (5) Opus numbers are those of Boccherini's autograph catalogue (as IMSLP and Gérard); the first-edition opus numbers (Op. 2, 9, 35, 38) are in aka.
